summary: First Mining Gold filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) attaching a Canadian Form 51-102F3 Material Change Report dated September 24, 2026, disclosing completion of a public offering of 68,459,500 common shares at C$0.84 per share for gross proceeds of C$57,505,980. Underwriters led by Haywood Securities, ATB Cormark and National Bank Financial exercised the 15% over-allotment option in full. Net proceeds fund the Springpole and Duparquet gold projects plus working capital. This is an ordinary equity shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and project milestones.
